counterfactual_missing_items: Total colonoscopy revealed no endoluminal lesion
decisive_items: Biopsy of the umbilical lesion demonstrated a well-differentiated, infiltrating adenocarcinoma

Contrast-enhanced abdominal CT showed homogeneously enhancing umbilical tissue growth and irregular, circumferential thickening of the right third of the transverse colon measuring approximately 8.3 cm
response.rationale: R4 is more comprehensive, including both the umbilical lesion and colonic thickening, while C1 only specifies the histology of the umbilical lesion

rejected.why: R1 is too general and does not account for the umbilical lesion
